# FD Portfolio

> Portfolio of FD, a DevOps Intern focused on Linux, infrastructure, Kubernetes and networking, with a strong interest in cybersecurity. Showcases hands-on projects, guides and personal security labs.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of FD's background, skills, projects and labs in DevOps, Linux, networking and cybersecurity.
- [Selected Work](/#work): Hands-on projects including the WPA2 Handshake Toolkit, an Arch Linux installation guide, a Kubernetes/Nextcloud environment, a personal homelab and T1D Investigator.
- [Labs](/#labs): Personal experiments — CCNA networking labs, Kali NetHunter on Nexus 5, Android rooting, ESP32 and Raspberry Pi.
- [Skills](/#skills): Technical skills across Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, networking, security tools and programming.
- [About](/#about): Background and focus areas — DevOps, Linux system administration and security.
- [Contact](/#contact): How to get in touch with FD.
